description: List the API routes, form actions, and procedures in a Node.js project that anyone can call: no recognizable auth check, or no input validation. Understands where auth runs in Next.js, SvelteKit, React Router/Remix, Express, Fastify, Hono, NestJS, and tRPC (middleware and its matcher, hooks, guards, route middleware, tRPC context). Runs offline. Static analysis: read the cited file before calling a route vulnerable.

check.description: auth: routes without an auth check; validation: routes without input validation; both (default).

maxResults.description: The most routes to return. Defaults to 100.

path.description: Absolute path of the project directory. Pass it: the server's working directory may not be the project. A relative path resolves against that working directory, the default.

name: find_unprotected_routes
title: Find unprotected API routes
